peopleAlsoAsk.question: Who guidelines on physical activity for children and adolescents?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Children and adolescents should do at least an average of 60 minutes per day of moderate- to vigorous-intensity, mostly aerobic, physical activity, across the week. Vigorous-intensity aerobic activities, as well as those that strengthen muscle and bone, should be incorporated at least 3 days a week.
